summary.text: Stanley Adkins is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 49, listed with Nicholas County. His legislative page lists committee assignments on Agriculture, Commerce, and Tourism, Government Organization and Local Government.

paragraphs.text: Adkins' page gives his birth date as July 10, 1949, and his birthplace as Richwood, West Virginia.
It lists a BSBA in accounting from West Virginia University and gives his occupation as certified public accountant.
It lists three sons, Aaron, Andrew and Adam.
